newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ sees inflation peaking at 2.3 pct in Sept 96.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ sees inflation peaking at 2.3 pct in Sept 96.

text.p: New Zealand's annual underlying inflation is projected to peak at 2.3 percent in the last two quarters of 1996, the Reserve Bank of New Zealand said in its six monthly Monetary Policy Statement on Tuesday.
The inflation rate is projected to ease to 2.0 percent in the March 1997 year and from there fall away rapidly, dropping to under 0.5 percent from March 1998.
In the bank's previous forecasts it predicted inflation would peak at at annual rate of 2.7 percent in the September 1996 year.
